gate: Selection among V2HO-KF64-s17 and V2HO-MR100-s17: rank by tune every-frame VOC among the variants whose tune annotated-frame VOC is >= control - 0.5; only the top-ranked variant is gated on confirm. Gate (as for V2HO-E3-s17 and the BN runs), against V2HO-HO0-s17 scored in the same pipeline: (a) every-frame VOC >= control + 1.0 on confirm and >= control + 0.5 on tune; (b) annotated-frame VOC >= control - 0.5 on both; (c) confirm video AP50 with the frozen linker and snap >= control - 2.0.
one_variable: model.native_motion_channel_ratio 0.25 -> 1.0: the full-rate actor-local motion fusion updates every channel instead of the last quarter; everything else is the V2HO-HO0-s17 recipe, seed 17, 30 epochs
purpose: Five attempts on detections at action boundaries (tube gating, action-free clips, segment erosion, three boundary-negative weightings) gained at most +0.45 every-frame mAP on held-out data. The semantic stream is temporally coarse (one VideoMAE token per 4 frames); these runs feed the dense heads sharper per-frame evidence instead. Low prior odds, stated before launch.
test_use: If the selected variant passes, its full-data model (trained in parallel: V2-WS2.0KF64 or V2-WS2.0MR100) is evaluated on split-1 test once under the frozen protocol and replaces V2-WS2.0 whatever its test result. Otherwise neither full-data model is evaluated on test.
